vya_text: dI0 - pAnIyamiti | kShuNNe kuTTite dravyapale kkAthyadravyapale pAnIyaM jalaM ShoDaSaguNaM dravyaBAgApekShayA, tena ShoDaSapalamityarthaH | aShTamAMSAvaSeShitamiti dvipalAvaSeShamityarthaH | tajjalamiti kkathitajalaM, koShNamiti IShaduShNaM, uShNatvamasya kkathitatvAdeva na tu SRutaSItaM punastaptamiti doShakaratvAt | tathAcoktam - `tailaM GRutaM ca pAnIyaM kaShAyaM vya~jjanAdikam | SRutaSItaM punastaptaM tatsarvaM viShavadBavet' iti | mRudvagnisAdhitamiti samyagvIryotkRuShTatvAt mandapAvakapAcitamiti BAvaH | dagdhaGanapicCilAdiBayAdityeke vadanti | dhImAniti grahaNena dravyANAM mRudumadhyakaThinatvAdikamavekShya tadanumAnaM jalaM deyamiti | tathAhi - `caturguNaM mRudau dravye kaThine~aShTaguNaM jalam | atyarthaM kaThine deyaM budhaiH ShoDaSikaM jalam' iti | etacca strehapAkaviShaye prAyaSaH pracarati | nanu mRudvAdikvAthyadravyamaShTaguNite jale sAdhyate iti vyavahAro dRuSyate tatkathamatra ShoDaSaguNam ? ucyate - kkAthyagaNo mRudumadhyakaThinadravyairmilitvA pacyate, tasmAt madhyamAnamanusaranti vRuddhavaidyA iti na doShaH | uktaM ca yataH -`mRudvAdikvAthyasa~gGAte mAnAnuktau cikitsakAH | madhyasyoBayaBAgitvAdicCantyaShTaguNaM jalam' iti | dravyamAnamapi doShApekShayA na tu niyatapalamAnamityeke BAShante | kutaH ? dhImAniti grahaNAt | tathAhi - `uttamasya palaM mAtrA triBiScAkShaiSca madhyamA | jaGanyasya palArdhena snehakvAthyauShadheShu ca ||' iti | etacca viShAdhikAre uktaM na tu sarvatra | nanvapare caturthAMSAvaSeShitaM kvAthaM vadanti | tathAhyuktam - `kvAthyadravyapale vAri dviraShTaguNamiShyate | caturBAgAvaSeShaM tu peyaM palacatuShTayam' | etadapi viShAdhikAre na tu sarvatra | yadvA kvAthastu pAcanAdikaBedena saptavidhaH | tadyathA -`pAcano dIpanIyaSca SodhanaH SamanastathA | tarpaNaH kledanaH SoShI kvAthaH saptavidho mataH' tasmAt pAcanaSodhanArthaM caturthAMSaH | `pAcanaH SodhanIyaSca pAdaSeShaH praSasyate' ityAdi vacanAt | avaSiShTArthaM ca dvipalamiti na virodhaH | yadvA doShAdInAM balAbalavicArAduBayatrApi na kaSciddoShaH | yataH `dIptAnalaM mahAkAyaM pAyayet tva~jjaliM jalam | anye tvardhaM parityajya prasRutiM tu cikitsakAH'iti || 1 ||

gU0 - idAnIM kvAthakalpanAM vyAKyAsyAmaH | pUrvaM tAvat tatsvarUpamAha - atha svarasAnantaraM kvAthasya nAmAnyAha - nanu pUrvaM `athAtra svarasaH kalkaH kvAthaSca himaPANTakau' ityevamuktatvAtsvarasAnantaraM kalkakalpanaiva yuktA tatkathamatra kvAthaH ? tathAca vAgBaTe BeShajakalpe evamuktam `rasaH kalkaH SRutaH SItaH PANTaSceti prakalpanA | pa~jcadhaiva kaShAyANAM pUrvaM pUrvaM balAdhikAH'| anyatrA~apyuktam - `rasaH kalkaSca niryUho PANTaH kramAdamI | yathottaraM ca laGavaH kaShAyAH pa~jca saMsmRutAH' | niryUhaH kvAthaH | ato vAgBaTAdau svarasAnantaraM kalka evoktaH anyairapyevamuktaM | nanu kecit SAr~ggadharapadye evaM paThanti `athAtra svarasaH kvAthaH kalkaSca himaPAMTakau' iti, tattu na samyak,yataH vAgBaTAdau svarasAnantaraM kalkasyaiva vidhAnAt | tataH kvAthaH | atra SAr~ggadhare tu svarasAnantaraM kvAtha evoktaH, kalkastu PANTAnantaramuktastatkathaM na vyatikramaH, ucyate - athAtra svarasaH kalkaH kvAthaSceti padyAtikrameNa liKitaM tat yathottaraM laGupratipAdanArthaM na tu kramakathanArtham | kramastu anukramaNikAyAM proktaH | tathA `svarasaH kvAthaPANTau ca himaH kalkaSca cUrNita'miti | ataH svarasAnantaraM kvAtha eva yuktaH sa procyate | mRutpAtre kShuNNe dravyapale ShoDaSaguNaM pAnIyaM kShipet punaH kvAthayet punarmRudvagnisAdhitaM aShTamAMSAvaSeShitaM dvipalamAtraM tajjalaM dhImAnvaidyaH pAyayet | kiMBUtaM jalaM koShNam IShaduShNaM, pAyayet rogiNam || 1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM kvAthasya paryAyanAmAnyAha - SRuta ityAdi | SRutaH, kvAthaH, kaShAyaH, niryUha iti catvAri kvAthasyaivAparanAmAni AtrAcAryo dvipalamiti svIkRutyoktamapyaparadRuShTAntena darSayati | tamAha - AhAra iti | vRuddhavaidyopadeSeneti grahaNena dvipalameva iti pAramparyo vyavahAraH, ata eva tanmatamAlocya SAr~ggadhareNAtra liKitaH, yataH `kvAthatyAgamanicCantastvaShTaBAgAvaSeShitam | pAramparyopadeSena vRuddhavaidyAH paladvayam' iti | supAcitamiti gandhavarNarasAnvitam | taduktam - `dravyasya gandhavarNaiSca tulyaM kAryakaraM viduH | tadvadviSuddhaM SuddhAya kaShAyamamRutopamam' iti| AhArarasapAke itipadamanyavyAdhiprakopavyavacCedArtham, yataH -. `auShadhaSeShe BuktaM pItaM ca tathauShadhaM saSeShe~anne | na karoti gadopaSamaM prakopayatyanyarogAMSca' iti || idAnIM prakShepanimittaM dravyANAM parimANamAha - kvAtha iti | sitA SarkarA, sA ca kkathitajalasya caturthAShTamaShoDaSairaMSaiH prakShiptA j~jeyA | atrAnukramo boddhavyaH | madhu ca viparItamiti SarkarAparimANAt, etena kimuktam ? vAtAta~gke sitAcaturthAMSaM kathitajalAdityarthaH, pittAta~gke~aShTamAMSaM, kaPAta~gke ShoDaSAMSamiti | madhu viparItaM yathA - vAtAta~gke ShoDaSAMSaM, pittAta~gke~aShTamAMSaM, caturthAMSamiti BAvaH || aparANyAha - jIrakamityAdi | jIrakAditrikaTukAntaM dravyaM Ta~gkapramitaM kShipediti kvAthe | tatra kShAraM yavakShArAdi, lavaNaM saindhavAdi, trikaTukaM SuNDImaricapippalIsaMj~jakam | dravaprakShepamAha - kShIramityAdi | kShIrAdIni karShamitAni tatra guDopalakShitattven sitAvaSiShTAH sarve ikShuvikArA gRuhyante | anyaddravamiti toyamadyAsavAriShTaSuktAdikaM, cUrNAdikamityatrAdigrahaNAt guTikAvalehAdayo boddhavyAH | karShaM palacaturthAMSamityarthaH ||2-6||

gU0 - AhArarasapAke sa~jjAte sati vRuddhavaidyopadeSena Aj~jayA supAcitaM kvAthaM pibet | SRuta:, kkAthaH, kaShAyaH, niryUhaSceti paryAyaSabdaiH kkAtha eva nigadyate | AhArarasapAke sa~jjAte iti yaduktaM tadrasaSeShe, auShadhapAke doShadarSanAt | yaduktaM `auShadhaSeShe BuktaM pItaM ca tathauShadhaM saSeShe~anne | na karoti gadopaSamaM prakarotyanyAn hi rogAMSca' iti | nanu vaidyAstu saMpradAyena dravyapale aShTaguNaM jalaM dattvA aShTamAMSaM gRuhItvA pAyayanti tatkathaM na virodhaH, dravyaM ShoDaSaBAgakaM | vRundava~ggasene caivamuktaM `kvAthadravyapale vAri dviraShTaguNamiShyate | caturBAgAvaSiShThaM tu peyaM palacatuShTayam' iti | palacatuShTayamiti tu mahAkAyaviShayam | tathAcoktaM - dIptAnalaM mahAkAyaM pAyayeda~jjaliM jalam | anye tvardhaM parityajya prasRutiM tu cikitsakAH' || vAgBaTe ca `kvAthaM dravyapale kuryAtprasthArdhaM pAdaSeShitam' | dravyapale prasthArdhaM jalaM datvA caturBAgAvaSeShitaM kvAthaM kuryAdityarthaH | aShTapalam | atra vAgBaTenAShThaguNaM jalaM tattu carakAdimatena, tathA coktaM suSrute - `yathAyogaM tvakpatramUlAdInAmAtapapariSoShitAnAM CedyAni KaNDAMSCedayitvA BedyAni KaNDaSo BedayitvA cAkuTyAShTaguNena ShoDaSaguNenAMBasAByaShicya sthAlyAM caturBAgAvaSiShTaM kvAthayitvApaharedityeSha kaShAyapAkakalpaH' | ataH ShoDaSaguNaM aShTaguNaM ca yuktameva BakShaNapramANam | astyAdyapekShayA atra kecidAhuH - `tvakpatramUlAdInAM BAgAccaturguNaM jalamavApya caturBAgAvaSiShTaM niShkkAthyApaharedityeShaH kaShAyapAkakalpaH' | tattu na samyak kasmAt ?
